THESE PROGRAMS SHALL BE PROVIDED IN THE SAS PROGRAMMING LANGUAGE, INCLUDING DOCUMENTATION, IN SUCH FORM THAT CAN BE RUN ON CMS COMPUTERS. THE CONTRACTOR SHALL ALSO PREPARE, IN COLLABORATION WITH CMS STAFF, RESEARCH ARTICLES FOR PUBLICATION.
